chunks: Now (it is) and indeed you were disobedient before and you were among the corrupters.

key_terms.الْمُفْسِدِينَ: The corrupters, those who spread mischief

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Al-ana' in Surah Yunus verse 98?
ai.summary: In this verse, Allah addresses Prophet Yunus (AS) with 'Al-ana' (Now), marking the transition from his mission to the finality of divine judgment upon the people of Nineveh. Shia scholars highlight that this moment confirms the efficacy of his preaching, as the people's subsequent belief was genuine despite their prior history of corruption and disobedience. The phrase underscores that divine mercy is extended even to those who were previously among the 'mufsidin' (corrupters) when they sincerely repent.
